members.name: TEXT_QST_082_MESSENGER_INTRO_01
members.text: Hey you! Theresa wants you to meet her at the Grey House!
members.speaker: BANDIT_MESSENGER

members.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_INTRO_02
members.text: So you've finally met Jack of Blades.
members.speaker: THERESA

members.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_INTRO_03
members.text: I met him long ago, of course. When he burned down our home and cut out my eyes.
members.speaker: THERESA

members.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_INTRO_04
members.text: But he wasn't lying when he said he knew where mother was.
members.speaker: THERESA

members.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_INTRO_05
members.text: He's kept her in Bargate Prison ever since the night of the raid.
members.speaker: THERESA

members.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_INTRO_06
members.text: I haven't been able to get inside, but the Archaeologist knows of an ancient secret passage.
members.speaker: THERESA

groups.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_SECOND_02
groups.content: You've met him already, haven't you? Jack's creatures are still after him, just like they're after me.
groups.speaker: THERESA

groups.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_SECOND_03
groups.content: I can't stay here much longer. I've left the details in a Quest Card at the Guild.
groups.speaker: THERESA

groups.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_SECOND_04
groups.content: You have to get Mother out. She's the only one who knows how to reach the Sword.
groups.speaker: THERESA

groups.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_SECOND_05
groups.content: You did read the book I sent, didn't you? The Sword is everything, and it could turn the world to nothing.
groups.speaker: THERESA

groups.name: TEXT_QST_082_THERESA_SECOND_06
groups.content: Oh, and Mother has a gift for you too. More power than you can imagine...
groups.speaker: THERESA

groups.name: TEXT_QUEST_THERESA_MOTHER_INFO_2_SUMMARY
groups.content: Meet Theresa outside the Grey House.
